bagPolicy.summary: Official venue guidance states a maximum bag size of 12 x 6 x 12 inches.
allowed: Bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Public parking lots are behind the venue. Valet is currently limited to Foundation Room members.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by House of Blues Dallas. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Food and a full bar are available during shows. Pay by card or mobile wallet. Free cash-to-card conversion is available.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Buy accessible seating online. Email HOBDallasInfo@LiveNation.com at least 30 days ahead for an interpreter or two days ahead for listening devices.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: You cannot return after leaving a show.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Collect will call on show day starting two hours before doors. Bring photo ID and the purchase card.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: House of Blues Dallas has accessible entrances. If you need accessible seating, arrive at least 15 minutes before door time and check in with security at the ADA stanchion just outside the security checkpoint so your party is seated ahead of the general admission line.
